purpose: Resolve whether the native M3D-C1 magnetic-probe interface is evidenced and usable for a simulation-native precursor, because the parent inventory found candidate magnetic/flux datasets but the Taylor baseline has imag_probes=0 and no configured probe coordinates.

interpretation_contract.forbidden_substitution: Do not substitute Jpk, dJpk/dt, sheet width, generic flux/current scalars, or FAIR-MAST absolute milliseconds for a physically identified native magnetic probe.
interpretation_contract.gate_note: No efficacy gate is evaluated by this read-only audit; any later controller claim must retain the frozen gates without loosening them.
interpretation_contract.claim_boundary: Normalized native M3D-C1 diagnostic provenance/enablement only; no precursor lead-time, controller-efficacy, experimental, or reactor-scale claim.
